A fragment of an iron hand-bell plated with copper-alloy using the 'fusion-plating process' (Bourke 1980; 1983). The bell is quadrangular in plan with a flat crown (top); only approximately one quarter of the crown survives. A circular patch of iron corrosion is visible at the top, perhaps representing the remains of the cross-piece (handle). This corrosion extends as a short stump underneath,…
